content.text:
The products page is fixed, and all 12 visual snapshots now match the approved baselines. I didn't run the functional tests, and I didn't approve or change any baselines.

**Cause:** in `site/css/components.css`, `.btn-secondary` had its text color set to `var(--color-surface)`, the same white as its background. The button labels (like the product card buttons) were invisible.

**Fix:** I changed the text color to `var(--color-ink)`.

The same bug showed up on other pages, which is why 8 of the 12 snapshots had diffs. The home "See plans" button, the pricing buttons and the orders "View", "Previous" and "Next" buttons were affected too, and the one-line fix covers them.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
